extractorArchitectures.name: Commercial Pilot Supercritical CO2 Extractor (5 L Autoclave, 350 bar, 316L SS, Threaded Pin Closure, ASME Section VIII Div 1)
extractorArchitectures.classification: Pilot Botanical Extraction Vessel (ASME Section VIII Div 1 / 3-A Sanitary)
extractorArchitectures.closureType: Precision ACME Threaded Plug with Peripheral Locking Pin
extractorArchitectures.sealConfiguration: FKM Viton 90 Shore A O-Ring with PTFE Backup Rings
extractorArchitectures.reliefValveType: Spring-Loaded Safety Relief Valve (SRV) with Heated Discharge Horn
extractorArchitectures.description: Standard pilot-scale supercritical CO2 extraction vessel for botanical essential oils, natural flavor fractions, and specialty food extracts. Operates up to 350 bar with precision PID heating jackets and heated back-pressure regulator to prevent dry-ice clogging.

extractorArchitectures.name: Industrial Dual-Vessel Production Skid (100 L × 2, 500 bar, 2205 Duplex SS, Quick Hydraulic Clamp, ASME Section VIII Div 2)
extractorArchitectures.classification: Commercial Industrial Dual Production Skid (ASME Section VIII Div 2 / CE-PED Module H1)
extractorArchitectures.vesselMaterial: Forged 2205 Duplex Stainless Steel (High Yield Strength)
extractorArchitectures.sealConfiguration: NORSOK M-710 Certified Anti-Explosive Decompression (AED) HNBR O-Ring with Spring-Energized PTFE Lip
extractorArchitectures.reliefValveType: Dual Pilot-Operated Safety Valves with Rupture Disc Interlock & Electric Heat Tracing
extractorArchitectures.description: High-throughput commercial extraction skid for hops alpha-acids, botanical oleoresins, and hemp seed extracts. Features dual staggered extraction chambers allowing continuous extraction while the secondary vessel is depressurized, unloaded, and recharged.

extractorArchitectures.name: Ultra-High-Pressure Continuous Cascade Extractor (500 L, 650 bar, Nitronic 50 SS, Breech-Lock Segmented Closure, ASME Div 3)
extractorArchitectures.classification: Heavy Industrial Ultra-High-Pressure Vessel (ASME Section VIII Div 3 / High Pressure Technology)
extractorArchitectures.closureType: Automated Hydraulic Breech-Lock Interrupted-Thread Closure with Dual Safety Interlocks
extractorArchitectures.sealConfiguration: FFKM Perfluoroelastomer with PEEK Anti-Extrusion Wedges and Metal C-Ring Energizer
extractorArchitectures.reliefValveType: Redundant Heated Full-Nozzle Relief Valves with Rupture Pin Isolation
extractorArchitectures.description: Heavy industrial decaffeination and defatting autoclave system. Utilizes supercritical fluid densities exceeding 0.90 g/cm³ for deep solvent extraction of green coffee beans and dairy lipids. Equipped with advanced automated pressure interlocks preventing vessel opening under residual pressure.

extractorArchitectures.name: Mechanically Compromised Aging Extractor (Gland Micro-Fissures, Standard Nitrile Seal, Unheated Relief Vent Orifice)
extractorArchitectures.classification: Hazardous Mechanically Degraded Unit (Severe Explosive Decompression & Cryogenic Dry-Ice Choke Risk)
extractorArchitectures.vesselMaterial: Sensitized 304 Stainless Steel (Evidence of Chloride Pitting)
extractorArchitectures.closureType: Manual Threaded Cap with Damaged Thread Flanks
extractorArchitectures.sealConfiguration: Standard 70 Shore A NBR Nitrile O-Ring (Non-AED, High CO2 Swell & Permeation)
extractorArchitectures.reliefValveType: Uninsulated Direct-Spring Relief Valve with Narrow 3 mm Vent Orifice (No Heat Tracing)
extractorArchitectures.description: Severely degraded extraction vessel operating with incompatible standard nitrile rubber seals. Glands exhibit abrasive galling, and the unheated relief discharge orifice is susceptible to catastrophic dry ice plugging during rapid venting.

extractionSubstrates.name: Brewing Hop Pellets & Essential Oils (Volatile Terpenes & Alpha Acids)
extractionSubstrates.description: Extraction of humulone, lupulone, and myrcene for commercial brewing bittering and aroma extracts. Operates under mild temperatures to avoid thermal oxidation of fragile terpenes.

extractionSubstrates.name: Green Coffee Beans (Water-Conditioned Decaffeination)
extractionSubstrates.description: Industrial decaffeination of pre-wetted green coffee beans. High pressure selectively extracts caffeine while preserving chlorogenic acids and aroma precursors.

extractionSubstrates.name: Botanical Oleoresins & Polyphenols (Ginger, Turmeric & Rosemary)
extractionSubstrates.depressurizationSensitivity: Severe (Viscous Resin Film on Seal Glands)
extractionSubstrates.description: Extraction of polar bioactive gingerols, curcuminoids, and carnosic acid using ethanol-modified supercritical CO2. Enhanced solvent polarity accelerates mass transfer but increases seal swelling.

extractionSubstrates.name: Specialty Cocoa Butter & High-Melting Triglycerides
extractionSubstrates.description: Ultra-high-pressure extraction of premium cocoa lipids and defatted functional powders. Demands rigorous heat tracing along all depressurization and separation lines to prevent lipid wax drop-out.

sealPolymerProfiles.name: NORSOK M-710 Certified AED Hydrogenated Nitrile (HNBR 90 Shore A)
sealPolymerProfiles.rgdResistance: Outstanding (Zero Internal Cracking up to 100 bar/min Depressurization)
sealPolymerProfiles.description: High-modulus elastomer formulated with specialized carbon black crosslinking to resist rapid gas decompression (RGD). Recommended for commercial cyclic extraction skids.

sealPolymerProfiles.name: Spring-Energized Modified PTFE with PEEK Anti-Extrusion Backups
sealPolymerProfiles.polymerClass: Fluoropolymer Composite with Elgiloy Cantilever Spring
sealPolymerProfiles.description: Machined fluoropolymer lip seal energized by a corrosion-resistant spring. Completely impervious to explosive decompression because supercritical CO2 cannot dissolve into the semi-crystalline fluoropolymer matrix.

sealPolymerProfiles.name: Standard Fluoroelastomer (FKM Viton 75 Shore A, Non-AED)
sealPolymerProfiles.rgdResistance: Poor (Prone to Internal Micro-Blistering above 15 bar/min)
sealPolymerProfiles.description: Standard industrial grade Viton. Dissolves significant supercritical CO2 at high pressures; rapid depressurization causes trapped gas to nucleate micro-voids, tearing the elastomer internally.

sealPolymerProfiles.name: Commercial Commodity Nitrile (NBR 70 Shore A, Low Modulus)
sealPolymerProfiles.rgdResistance: Critical Failure (Severe Explosive Rupture & Extrusion Shredding)
sealPolymerProfiles.description: Non-compliant commodity rubber seal. Massive plasticization and swelling under supercritical CO2 leading to explosive decompression blowout, extrusion nibbling, and complete loss of vessel containment.
